title: The Collapse, the Thermal Bounce, the Inflating Universe and the Trailing Dark Energy
content: The objective of the paper is to offer a complete model for inflation avoiding singularities. It is essentially a revision of the ideas presented in [14,15]. Our model starts with a collapsing object, e.g. a star or a collection of stars, which via a bounce and a succeeding inflation and continued expansion gives output parameters agreeing with all observed cosmological parameters as well as continuously providing a well defined frame of rest. The method of our investigation is a computer simulation of a collapse-bounce-inflation-expanding- Friedmann universe. The results of the model are output parameters agreeing with the observed cosmological parameters, the power index of the CMB, the running of the power index, the present Hubble constant, dark energy density, matter and dark matter density and the radiation density.
